To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the energy-efficient design of UAV communication is a challenging task, and the proposed designs can achieve a significant improvement in terms of energy efficiency as compared with other benchmarks.

the energy efficiency is maximized with the UAV flying at a constant speed and direction, which are jointly determined by the UAV’s initial/final locations, minimum/maximum speed, and acceleration constraints.

(a) the energy efficiency of a circular UAV trajectory increases with the UAV’s flight speed and radius, (b) for the general case, the optimal energy efficiency can be found with the help of a simple algorithm that is easy to implement, and (c) for the general constrained case, the energy efficiency can be maximized by jointly optimizing the UAV’s flight path and speed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of energy-efficient UAV communication by jointly optimizing the UAV’s flight trajectory and the ground terminal’s transmission power.
the energy-efficient design of UAV communication, which is an important step towards the realization of UAV communication systems.
the energy-efficient UAV communication by jointly optimizing the UAV’s communication and propulsion, and provides a new perspective for the design of energy-efficient UAV communication systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
UAVs are a very promising technology in the context of 5G and beyond.
the UAV trajectory optimization problem is a non-trivial one and that there are many interesting and challenging problems that remain to be solved.
energy-efficient UAV communication is possible by jointly optimizing the UAV’s flight path and speed, which is a novel design paradigm for UAV communication.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the energy-efficient design is a key factor to be considered for the UAV’s trajectory optimization in future wireless communication systems.
the energy efficiency of a UAV communication system is a function of both the communication rate and the UAV’s flight speed, and thus should be jointly optimized.
the trajectory optimization for UAV communication can significantly improve the energy efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the energy efficiency of fixed-wing UAV communication can be greatly improved with carefully designed UAV trajectories, and that the UAV’s energy-efficient communication is possible even when the UAV flies at a relatively large distance from the ground terminal.
the energy efficiency of the UAV communication can be substantially improved by jointly optimizing the UAV’s flight trajectory and speed.
, in order to achieve high energy efficiency, the trajectory of a fixed-wing UAV should be carefully designed to balance the UAV’s energy cost with the communication throughput.
